type: Computerized lockstitch machine with backstitch stepping motor
source: Operation Manual of AMH Electrical Control V1.1_20230928 (A5E-A electric control box manual, 16 pages)
note: The AMH machine uses the A5E-A electronic control box. Features a 20-button panel. Has backstitch stepping motor (Err-21 to Err-29). User parameters P00-P43 (long-press P), Technician parameters P47-P304 (hold P at power-on).

buttons.name: Stitch length adjustment key
buttons.description: Stitch length adjustment key, press + to increase or press - to decrease stitch length in idle state

buttons.name: Presser foot height setting
buttons.description: Press to change the height of presser foot lifting in idle state

buttons.name: Front hardening key
buttons.description: Front solid joint function selection key. Each press cycles: front solid joint → front double solid joint → close cycle. Corresponding LCD icon lights up. Select key to set number of pins in segment A and B.

buttons.name: Rear hardening key
buttons.description: After solid seam function selection key. Each press cycles: after solid seam → after double solid seam → close cycle. Corresponding LCD icon lights up. Select key to set number of pins in segment C and D.

buttons.name: Clamping function
buttons.description: 1. Press to toggle LCD thread tension icon on (line clamping function on). Press again to turn off. 2. When bird's nest is opened, thread clamping function is forced open and key is invalid.

buttons.name: Press foot lift key
buttons.description: Short press: cycles presser foot lifting selection: on → midway on → on after trim → midway off after trim → off after trim → off → (repeat). Long press: turn on or off the presser foot lift function.

buttons.name: Trimmer key
buttons.description: Press briefly to switch the automatic thread trimming function on/off.

buttons.name: Mode switch key
buttons.description: Press briefly to switch the working mode of the sew machine. Sequence: free sew → W sew → multi-section sew.

buttons.name: Needle position section key
buttons.description: Short press to switch the up and down needle stop position.

buttons.name: Pattern sew key / Piecework interface key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to enter pattern sew mode. In pattern sew mode, short press to switch between pattern sew interface and pattern sew setting interface. 2. Long press to enter or exit the piece counting mode.

buttons.name: P (Parameter mode)
buttons.description: Enter the parameter function.

buttons.name: Up key (speed up)
buttons.description: In this mode, adjust this key to increase speed.

buttons.name: Down key (speed down)
buttons.description: In this mode, adjust this key to decrease speed.

buttons.name: Left key
buttons.description: Turn to left to choose parameter.

buttons.name: Right key
buttons.description: Turn to right to choose parameter.

buttons.name: Reset key
buttons.description: Long press to back to factory setting.

buttons.name: Locksew key
buttons.description: Short press cycles: front condense stitch → rear condense stitch → front and rear condense stitch → close.

buttons.name: Voice key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to toggle voice function and power-on language: voice function on → power-on language on → power-on language off → voice function off. 2. Short press to broadcast voice navigation when reporting an error.

buttons.name: Clamping function without any thrum
buttons.description: 1. Only N model can be operated. Short press to set used or cancelled clamping function without any thrum. 2. Long press to enter the quick adjustment interface of clamping function without any thrum.

buttons.name: Automatic triggering of multi segment sewing
buttons.description: 1. Switch through parameter item P34.

userParams.access: Press P button → use Left/Right to navigate parameters → use Up/Down to adjust value → press P to save and exit

technicianParams.access: Hold P button while powering on machine → technician parameter mode → same navigation as user params

monitoringMode.access: Press P + press foot lifter key simultaneously → monitoring mode → press up/down to navigate monitoring items → press P to save (for items 24, 25, 26, 28)
monitoringMode.upperNeedleStop: Enter monitoring item 24, adjust handwheel to up needle position, long press P to save

quickAdjustMode.access: Long press P + stitch length plus key → Quick Parameter Adjustment Mode → press Up/Down to switch options

options.description: Set stepper motor zero position — place paper on needle plate, sew without thread, check needle operates in hole
Adjust stitch length overlap for reverse sew 4.0 (min 10 stitches)
Adjust stitch length overlap for reverse sew 5.0 (min 5 stitches)
Adjust stitch length overlap for reverse sew 3.0 (min 5 stitches)
Adjust stitch length overlap for reverse sew 2.0 (min 5 stitches)
Adjust presser foot height — measure with gauge block at 1mm and press P to save

parameterEntry.languageChange: Long press voice button, switch parameters with Up/Down keys. Languages: 0=English, 1=Spanish, 2=Portuguese, 3=Russian, 4=Arabic, 5=Vietnamese, 6=Farsi, 7=Bengali, 8=Turkish, 9=Indonesian, 10=Polish, 11=Italian, 12=Thai, 13=Ukrainian (multi-lingual version only)
parameterEntry.factoryReset: Long press Reset key to restore all factory defaults

pieceworkMode.enter: Long press pattern sew key (button 10) to enter piece counting interface
pieceworkMode.exit: Long press piece counting icon OR short press free sew icon
pieceworkMode.clearV01: Directly adjust v01 to 0 and save it
pieceworkMode.standby: Press scissors button to enter standby mode (AMH machine indicator light flashes). Press again to exit standby.
pieceworkMode.productionDataClear: Set v13=1 to clear piece count and efficiency data. Set v13=2 to restore all piecework parameters to factory defaults.
pieceworkMode.passwordLock: Set password via v12. Must restart machine for password to take effect. Change v12 to correct password to decrypt.

errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. 2. Check whether arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control are damaged or in poor conditions. 3. If still fails after troubleshooting and restart, contact local service provider.
Same as Err-01.
Disconnect controller power and check if input power supply voltage is lower than 176V. If so, restart controller after voltage returns to normal. Contact local service provider if still fails.
Disconnect controller power and check if input power voltage is higher than 264V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. Contact local service provider if still fails.
Same as Err-04.

errorCodes.description: Arm shaft motor current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Try a few times. If fault occurs frequently, contact local service provider.

1. Check for foreign objects wrapped around machine head, thread residue in rotating shuttle, or eccentric wheel stuck. 2. Check if input plug of arm shaft motor power supply is detached, loose, or damaged. 3. Contact service provider if still fails.
1. Check connection between operation panel and electric control — drops off, loose, or broken. 2. Contact service provider if still fails after restart.

errorCodes.description: Arm shaft motor initial angle detection failure
errorCodes.solution: Try 2-3 times again after power off. If still fails, contact local service provider.

errorCodes.description: Arm shaft motor zero position fault
errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. 2. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. 3. Contact service provider if still fails.
Power off system and power on again 30 seconds later. If controller still fails, contact local service provider or dial 4008876858.
1. Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. 2. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. 3. Contact service provider if still fails.
Same as Err-15.
Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. If still fails, contact local service provider.
Check whether arm shaft motor is stalled. If not, contact local service provider.
Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. If still fails, contact local service provider.
1. Check if connection cable of pedal speed controller is dropped off, loose, or damaged. 2. Contact service provider if still fails after restart.
Turn off system power, check the socket of the reverse sew motor, and restart the electric control. If error still reported, contact local service provider.
Same as Err-21.

troubleshooting.issue: Machine prompts error via voice but no error code visible
troubleshooting.solution: Note the error code being announced. Press Voice key (button 18) to hear the broadcast again. Refer to error code table Err-01 to Err-30.

troubleshooting.cause: v09 not set to 1, or v10 piecework unit wrong
troubleshooting.solution: Enter piecework interface. Set v09=1 (automatic piecework). Set v10 to the number of thread cuts per piece.
